title: The House Gets $10 Million — But Nobody Can Leave

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Ten million dollars. Yours, if nobody leaves this house.

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: Finally. My refusal to exercise has investors.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Max, the front door just grew teeth!

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Delivery fee: nine million, nine hundred thousand dollars.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: The dinosaur is eating our money!

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: Stop! That is our retirement salad!

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Congratulations. He bought the house. Your rent starts now.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Do we escape through the toilet, or negotiate with our landlord?

description: The House Gets $10 Million — But Nobody Can Leave. A  TOILET ESCAPE or B  DINO LANDLORD? Tell us your choice in the comments. Fictional animated comedy. #AIHOUSE #Shorts #AnimatedComedy
